context_requirements: Expression of a pyruvate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase (PFOR) or PFOR-like enzyme; human cells lack this enzyme
Anaerobic or microaerophilic metabolism relying on PFOR for acetyl-CoA production
Presence of ferredoxin as an electron carrier
falsifiers: Any reproducible concentration-dependent transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine human cell lines
Enrichment of a specific gene signature shared across cell lines that is not explained by generic stress or cytotoxicity
Evidence that the compound is metabolized to a reactive species causing oxidative stress or DNA damage
